newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUSTRIAN NATBANK ALLOTS 6.58 BLN ATS IN REPOS.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIAN NATBANK ALLOTS 6.58 BLN ATS IN REPOS.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank on Thursday allocated 6.58 billion schillings in two-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed and unchanged rate of three percent.
The bank said it filled five percent of the bids.
Last week the bank allotted 15.27 billion schillings in repos, filling 12 percent of the bids, also at a fixed rate of three percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
